run_summaries.notes: Initial seed list. Searches returned mostly news/media due to Dia de Muertos and security stories; focused on relevant Mexican agro/industrial/B2B accounts. Low volume of individual small business posts this hour.

Second hourly run. Continued low volume of pure small-business posts amid news cycle (Día de Muertos, crime, sports). Added diverse relevant accounts: family carpentry supplier, industrial infrastructure firm, plastic industry expo, restaurant cost coverage, livestock tech author, traditional ganadería, industrial analysis, producer-support media, avocado issue poster, and official agro financier. Prioritized quality and category coverage.

Third hourly run. Volume of individual small-business or seller posts remains low amid Día de Muertos news and institutional announcements. Added quality relevant accounts: agroindustry magazine, national agro council, northwest business portal with producer interviews, Guanajuato entrepreneurship integrator, primary sector informativo, export consulting for local products, Puebla animal welfare/vet account, and Agriculture Secretary announcement on producer incentives. Maintained diversity across agro, associations, entrepreneurs, and veterinary categories.

Fourth hourly run. Continued low volume of direct small-business seller posts (mostly news cycle around avocado phytosanitary issues, Día de Muertos and institutional supports). Added 5 quality relevant accounts: Capital México coverage of producer protection legislation, Sinaloa regional portal on wheat producer payments, architectural feature on Querétaro ganadería, Puebla synthesis media on pest protocols, and Sonora coverage of scaling food entrepreneur with restaurants. Prioritized diversity and genuine B2B relevance.
